review.reviewer: Independent visual reviewer; explicitly loaded image_visual role instructions

objective.evidence: One rounded-square tile contains a recognizable abstract folded-paper bird, with cobalt, lavender and peach panels.

text_facts.evidence: No readable text or watermark appears.

composition.evidence: The complete tile has clear surrounding margins; the bird fills the tile without clipping its beak, wings or tail.

brand_reference.evidence: The palette, folded-paper material and premium bird-icon concept correspond to the official example. Darker tile artwork and a different fold arrangement are acceptable fresh-generation variations.

visual_integrity.evidence: Paper panels have coherent folds and distinct edges; the beak, raised wing and tail read clearly as a bird. Rounded tile corners form a continuous contour.

preservation.evidence: Fresh text-only generation; source pixels and exact artwork geometry were not preservation targets.

transparency.evidence: Light and dark composites show clean transparency outside every tile edge and rounded corner. No exterior shadow, broad color haze or additional background rectangle is visible.
